تبتلعي (form VIII)
# تَبْتَلِعِي (tabtaliʕī) /tab.ta.li.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
# تُبْتَلَعِي (tubtalaʕī) /tub.ta.la.ʕiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَلَعَ (ibtalaʕa)
